notes: Version 2.32 records Gravity 3.5 and its consumer cascade (Q12 1.6, Q13 1.6, EG-Note 2.2, SG-Note 2.3, LC-O2 1.3). Gravity works on a supplied Riemannian metric: its identification with an operator built from the admissibility data is not established, [H-lift] is open and not discharged by Q9, Q5b gives a rank-three co-metric, no metric coefficient value is established, and reading the metric as emergent needs a supplied rank-four extension and a continuation that is not performed. The infrared dominance of the Einstein term is typed as structural and conditional (a non-zero matched coefficient and R L_4^2 << 1, by power counting, with no general bound on the non-local terms). The Born-Infeld classification has a second freedom: the spectral carrier is fixed only up to a trace parameter alpha, which leaves the linear term unchanged and moves the saturation boundary. LC-O2 uses a supplied Lorentzian co-metric with a postulated flat temporal reference, and its weak-field corollary restates the lapse of a supplied metric. The registry entries, table rows and graph nodes are updated; the edges Q11 to Gravity and Gravity to LCII are removed as result dependencies, and a conditional edge Q11 to LCII records the homogeneous form LCII takes from Q11 Corollary 6.1.
